text: Men eltani Sulaymaana henndu ndun ko ndu saɗtundu wifugol hindu doga e yamiroore makko tuma nde o yamiri ndu faade ka leydi Saami ndi Men barkiniri e mu'un sabu ko Men Nuli kon e mayri immorde e Annabaaɓe, e moƴƴi weftaaɗi e mayri, Men laatike kala huunde ko Men annduɓe, hay e huunde suuɗotaako Men e ɗum.
